'''Chitin''' is a [[material]] found in the [[Ocean]]. 

It is obtained by mining [[Abyssal Barnacle]]s found on [[Leviathan]]s which appear as living, moving islands in the [[Ocean]]. Catching a [[Coral Cod]] fish has a 13.33% of dropping 1-2 chitin, although catching them requires [[Heavy Fishing Bait]] (which can be difficult to obtain).

=== Crafting ===

Beyond quality 4, the Dyrnwyn can be upgraded further at the [[Forge of Potential]] with a [[Flametal Battle Idol]]. ==Tips== *Weapons that do [[spirit]] damage such as the [[Mistwalker]] or [[Silver Sword]] may be more effective at dealing with some [[Ashlands]] enemies such as the [[Charred Warrior]] due to the damage bonus against undead enemies. ==External link== *[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ba9VJrzV4Ww Lord Reto Guide - How To Get The New Flaming Sword Dywnwyn] ==Trivia== * The Dyrnwyn, meaning "white-hilt" was a powerful sword that was part of the [[wikipedia:Thirteen_Treasures_of_the_Island_of_Britain|Thirteen Treasures of the Island of Britain]], a series of items from late medieval (15th-16th century) Welsh tradition. It was said to have been owned by [[wikipedia:Rhydderch_Hael|Rhydderch Hael]], one of the Three Generous Men of Britain mentioned in the [[wikipedia:Welsh_Triads|Welsh Triads]]. When drawn by a worthy or well-born man, the entire blade would blaze with fire. Rhydderch was never reluctant to hand the weapon to anyone, hence his nickname Hael, meaning "the Generous", but the recipients, as soon as they had learned of its peculiar properties, always rejected the sword. * While being an [[Ashlands]]-tier weapon, it existed and was obtainable before the Ashlands update using console commands. Its previous ID was SwordIronFire, it dealt 55 slash and 30 fire damage, had 200 durability and used 14 stamina. ** Despite it being uncraftable before the Ashlands update, it used to have a recipe as well as upgrades up to quality 4 defined internally.
